title: Blue Cows
description: This Texturepack Adds Blue Normal Minecraft Cows. Inspired By :_Godlycow
body: This is a Minecraft texture pack that transforms the **normal cows into blue cows**. Why? Well, its because my plugin-maker friend uses a blue cow skin, and I thought it would be fun to bring that idea into the game itself. So I created this pack as a small Contribution and a playful twist on the classic cow mob. Thanks _( _Godlycow )_ for Inspiration
